subject: Re: Kickoff: contrastive RL as our goal-conditioned baseline
body:
Ulla,

Staffing + infra:

- Hyun Traore 70%, algorithm and the head-to-head evaluation.
- Carmen Reyes 40%, image-based environments and the offline data pipeline.
- Jorge Vidal, see below.

Compute: 96 GPUs on vulcan-h100, reserved through Ines for the May and June sweeps. Note vulcan is down 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-24 for maintenance, so the image-task sweep has to land before the 19th anyway.

The part that needs your sign-off: to make the head-to-head credible across five environments and three seeds each we need somewhere to put the results that isn't a spreadsheet. We are building a benchmark leaderboard service from scratch - submission API, run registry, per-task success-rate tables, and a public-facing web view. Jorge Vidal owns it at 50% from April 20 through the end of June. It's about six weeks of work and it outlives this project.

Deshawn
